The '''Majoor sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Ansillivog]], [[Insta-7]], [[Majoor]], [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]] and [[Ragith III]].
